reason: The patch changes messages_en.properties:3138 from {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to MessageFormat {0}/{1}/{2} plus {2,choice,...}. The admin UI uses plain i18next with no ICU plugin and default {{ }} interpolation (js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-34), and ThemeResource.java:141-143 serves the values unchanged, so t() in ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:79-85 shows the raw placeholders and the choice text. The patch also adds a special case for this key in VerifyMessageProperties.java to work around the '<' in the choice text.
